label.en: The daily publication, from source to screen
label.zh-Hant: 每日發布：從來源到畫面

note.en: Run numbers are from the Dev and Prod publishers' public `/health` read on 2026-10-20 (last runs 2026-10-19 22:07 and 22:37 UTC).
note.zh-Hant: 執行數字取自 2026-10-20 讀取的 Dev 與 Prod 發布器公開 `/health`（最近一次執行：2026-10-19 22:07 與 22:37 UTC）。

lead.en: Each environment has its own Worker with its own cron, so Dev and Prod never share state. Publication was hourly until 2026-10-13 and is now daily to cut R2 cost (Spec 018).
lead.zh-Hant: 每個環境各有一個 Worker 與自己的 cron，Dev 與 Prod 不共用狀態。發布原本每小時一次，2026-10-13 起改為每天一次以降低 R2 成本（Spec 018）。

v.en: Data can be up to about 24 hours old; a token-protected manual trigger publishes sooner.
v.zh-Hant: 資料最多約 24 小時舊；要更早發布只能用需要 token 的手動觸發。

lead.en: Forty minutes after the Dev publication, the weekly digest reads the snapshot that was just published. If a publication is still running it waits 15 minutes, at most 4 times.
lead.zh-Hant: Dev 發布後 40 分鐘，週報讀取剛發布的快照。若發布還在跑，就延後 15 分鐘，最多 4 次。

lead.en: A run that hit a source's per-run cap runs again 5 minutes later (at most 5 times); a failed run is retried after 10, 30 and 60 minutes. One trigger causes at most 9 publications.
lead.zh-Hant: 某個來源達到單次上限的 run，5 分鐘後再跑一次（最多 5 次）；失敗的 run 在 10、30、60 分鐘後重試。一次觸發最多造成 9 次發布。

lead.en: Read with the GitHub REST API from an updated-time cursor, at most 200 issues per repository per run; the rest is caught up by follow-up runs.
lead.zh-Hant: 用 GitHub REST API 依更新時間游標讀取，每個 repo 每次最多 200 筆，其餘由後續的追趕 run 補上。

lead.en: Anonymous reads of the Apache Jira search API over a window that grows with the gap since the last success.
lead.zh-Hant: 匿名讀取 Apache Jira 搜尋 API，時間視窗依上次成功至今的間隔放大。

lead.en: KIP discussions and votes live here. Subjects starting `[jira]` or `[PR]` are dropped because those records already come from Jira and GitHub.
lead.zh-Hant: KIP 的討論與投票都在這裡。主旨以 `[jira]` 或 `[PR]` 開頭的信會被略過，因為這些已由 Jira 與 GitHub 收集。

v.en: One retry after a 5xx or 429; a response over 4 MiB fails that source as `too-large`; a failing source never blocks the others.
v.zh-Hant: 5xx 或 429 重試一次；回應超過 4 MiB 時該來源以 `too-large` 失敗；一個來源失敗不會擋住其他來源。

lead.en: Who reviewed what and when, without comment text; it feeds contributor profiles.
lead.zh-Hant: 誰在何時 review 了什麼，不含留言內容；用於貢獻者頁面。

lead.en: Holds each source's cursor, the current phase and the last run, so a crash resumes from the last committed cursor instead of starting over.
lead.zh-Hant: 保存每個來源的游標、目前階段與上一次 run；程式中途掛掉時，會從最後提交的游標續跑，而不是從頭開始。

lead.en: Reads every source sequentially from its cursor.
lead.zh-Hant: 依游標逐一讀取每個來源。

lead.en: A deterministic TypeScript materializer groups records into threads and extracts identifiers such as `KIP-1150` from titles and bodies. The same input always gives the same output.
lead.zh-Hant: 確定性的 TypeScript materializer 把紀錄整理成 thread，並從標題與內文抽出 `KIP-1150` 這類編號。相同輸入一定得到相同輸出。

lead.en: An immutable snapshot: a list of entries plus one detail object per thread. A detail is stored once under the SHA-256 of its bytes and reused by later releases (content addressing).
lead.zh-Hant: 不可變的快照：一份列表加上每個 thread 的詳細物件。詳細物件以內容的 SHA-256 為鍵只存一次，之後的 release 直接重用（內容定址）。

v.en: Dev 791 new + 7,796 reused objects; Prod 378 new + 7,596 reused
v.zh-Hant: Dev 新增 791、重用 7,796 個物件；Prod 新增 378、重用 7,596 個

lead.en: Chunks every thread, computes corpus statistics once, and writes BM25 shards plus a `terms.json` that says which shard holds each term. See [Search](search.html).
lead.zh-Hant: 把每個 thread 切成段落，一次算好語料統計，寫出 BM25 分片與記錄每個詞在哪些分片的 `terms.json`。詳見[搜尋](search.html)。

v.en: Dev 9,764 chunks in 11 shards; Prod 7,118 chunks in 8 shards
v.zh-Hant: Dev 9,764 段、11 個分片；Prod 7,118 段、8 個分片

lead.en: Objects are written first and the small `current.json` pointers last, so a reader sees either the old release or the new one, never half of one. The run then records what it wrote and what it cost.
lead.zh-Hant: 先寫物件，最後才更新小小的 `current.json` 指標，所以讀者看到的一定是完整的舊版或新版，不會看到一半。接著記錄這次寫了什麼、花了多少。

v.en: Dev 794 Class A / 8,590 Class B; Prod 381 / 7,977

lead.en: Per-person monthly activity files for contributor profiles (`PEOPLE_ACTIVITY=log@1`).
lead.zh-Hant: 為貢獻者頁面寫入每人每月的活動檔（`PEOPLE_ACTIVITY=log@1`）。

lead.en: Turns each new search chunk into a vector for semantic search, capped at 2,500 estimated neurons and 400 calls a day.
lead.zh-Hant: 把新的搜尋段落轉成向量供語意搜尋使用，每天上限 2,500 估計 neurons、400 次呼叫。

lead.en: Classifies, summarises, validates and translates the last 7 days. See [Weekly digest](digest.html).
lead.zh-Hant: 分類、摘要、驗證並翻譯過去 7 天的動態。詳見[週報](digest.html)。

lead.en: The only mutable objects. Everything they point to is immutable, so rollback is a pointer change.
lead.zh-Hant: 唯一會變動的物件；它指向的內容都不可變，所以回復只要改指標。

lead.en: One release per run; details shared by content digest across releases.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次 run 一個 release；詳細物件依內容雜湊在各 release 間共用。

lead.en: Versioned independently of the feed, so the ranker can change without touching the feed.
lead.zh-Hant: 與 feed 分開版本化，排序演算法可以獨立更換。

lead.en: The English digest and its Traditional Chinese translation for one source release.
lead.zh-Hant: 某一份來源 release 的英文週報與繁體中文翻譯。

lead.en: Evidence of each publication, and on Dev the review and activity month files. Not served directly.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次發布的證據，以及 Dev 上的 review 與活動月檔；不直接對外提供。

meta.zh-Hant: cosine · 每個專案一個 namespace

lead.en: Cloudflare's vector database, behind a replaceable interface so it is never the public contract.
lead.zh-Hant: Cloudflare 的向量資料庫，放在可替換的介面後面，不成為對外契約。

lead.en: A Durable Object ledger that every semantic query must pass, so a public search box cannot overspend. Over budget means lexical results only.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個語意查詢都要經過的 Durable Object 帳本，讓公開搜尋框不會超支；超過預算就只回傳關鍵字結果。

lead.en: Reads the pointer, then the release, then one detail object. Every 200 response is cached for 30 seconds with stale-while-revalidate 120. The browser never touches R2.
lead.zh-Hant: 先讀指標，再讀 release，再讀一個詳細物件。每個 200 回應快取 30 秒、stale-while-revalidate 120 秒。瀏覽器從不直接碰 R2。

lead.en: Reads `current.json`, the manifest, `terms.json`, then only the shards a query term names.
lead.zh-Hant: 讀 `current.json`、manifest、`terms.json`，再只讀查詢詞出現的分片。

lead.en: Return 404 on Prod because the features are off there.
lead.zh-Hant: 因為 Prod 未開啟這些功能，所以在 Prod 回 404。

lead.en: The digest: headline, highlights, KIP proposals, topic cards, collapsed routine maintenance.
lead.zh-Hant: 週報：標題、重點、KIP 提案、主題卡片、收合的例行維護。

lead.en: The thread list with search in the same view, and a detail page per thread with its full timeline and source links.
lead.zh-Hant: thread 列表與同一畫面的搜尋，以及每個 thread 的詳細頁（完整時間軸與來源連結）。

meta.zh-Hant: 逾時 > 24.5 小時 · 過期 > 27 小時

lead.en: Every view shows how old the data is, so a stalled publisher is visible without anyone reading logs.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個畫面都顯示資料多舊，發布器卡住時不必看 log 也看得出來。

lead.en: Public, read-only status of the last run: per-source success, objects written, R2 requests, search index size, AI spend today. It never returns credentials.
lead.zh-Hant: 公開、唯讀的上次執行狀態：各來源是否成功、寫了多少物件、R2 請求數、搜尋索引大小、今天的 AI 用量。不會回傳任何憑證。

lead.en: A committed command that compares `/health` with what the site serves, for Dev or Prod, using GET only.
lead.zh-Hant: 版本庫內的指令，只用 GET 比對 `/health` 與網站實際提供的資料，可對 Dev 或 Prod 執行。
